g.text: Shared accountability record: proposal → decision → authority → claim → dispatch → receipt. Caches and indexes are rebuildable projections of

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1f3a5f
font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6773

g.text: Deployment controls determine which paths are actually mediated. A separate credential, an unmanaged host, an unprotected approval pipeline or a

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6773

g.text: target-side rule outside the tested boundary is outside the guarantee.
